# EmbeddingGemma model terms

The unmodified EmbeddingGemma model is provided under the accompanying Google Gemma Terms of Use, including its Section 3.2 restrictions and incorporated Gemma Prohibited Use Policy. Use and redistribution of this bundled model are subject to those terms. The license for Meeting Mac source code does not replace or relax these model terms.

The accompanying LICENSE is the original model-license blob from the official Ollama EmbeddingGemma manifest; its pinned digest is recorded in docs/spec/builtin-assets-v0.3.json. Notice is retained as required by that text. Distribution packaging retains this entire directory alongside the model.
